home.tagline: Describe your website. Get domain names that fit it — free and paid, grouped by price, explained, and checked daily.
home.how1: Describe your website in a sentence or two.
home.how2: We work out what kind of site it is and create name ideas that fit.
home.how3: You get available names grouped by price, with reasons.

footer.disclaimer: We recommend names; registrars sell them. Availability can change at any time.

policy.draft: This is a short summary. The full policy will be published before the public launch.
privacyPoints: You can search without an account.
We don't keep your website description: it is used for your search and then forgotten.
Saved items, once saving is available, are stored on our servers and can be seen by the site operator.
termsPoints: We suggest domain names; we do not sell or register them.
Availability and prices can change at any time and are not guaranteed.
We do not check trademarks — please check before you buy.
Do not use this service for phishing, impersonation or anything illegal.
